_what: DIAGNOSTIC decomposition of the m9s6 mix verdict; decides nothing, read by no rule
reading: m9s6 is a SUBSTITUTION test at fixed budget. Its 17.9M document tokens contribute between -0.00235 and -0.00017 SCREEN-3, depending on how the query-only counterfactual is estimated: the anchor curve is strongly concave (gain/Mtok 0.00220 -> 0.00095 -> 0.00022), so LINEAR interpolation understates the counterfactual and is the OPTIMISTIC end for documents (Codex, 2026-08-30). The whole range sits inside the MDE 0.0056, so the defensible claim is: documents are NOT DISTINGUISHABLE FROM NEUTRAL at this dose. The stronger claim -- that the entire deficit is the query-token cut -- is NOT supported and was withdrawn.
caveat: neutral-per-token at 11 query epochs is NOT evidence that documents help at 110. Both remain unmeasured at build dose; the build is that test.
surface_caveat: the decomposition is computed on SCREEN-3, the surface with 4 checkpoints; the m9s6 VERDICT was decided on DEV-6 (-0.00604), read once at the final checkpoint. The decomposition therefore explains a SCREEN-3 deficit and is evidence about, not a decomposition of, the DEV-6 number.
_bound_method: upper bound on the query-only counterfactual for a concave curve: walk back from the measured 44.63M-token checkpoint using the SHALLOWER subsequent slope (0.000216/Mtok). An earlier attempt extrapolated the STEEP first-segment slope and produced 0.5074 -- above the anchor's own final 0.49862, i.e. not a bound at all. Corrected.
